name: surabhi3011/internfeel
description: InternFeel: custom WordPress theme and plugin. Dev tools only; the plugin's runtime dependencies live in its own vendor/.

scripts.syntax: find wp-content/themes/internfeel wp-content/plugins/internfeel-core wp-content/mu-plugins dev -name '*.php' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
